bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (Contact store, search); springboard/apps/contacts-desktop (Contacts app); springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs (vCard export); springboard/sdk/src/quicksearch.rs (Spotlight index)
summary: Apple deprecated this framework in macOS 10.11 and points to the Contacts framework, which is not in this batch. BifrOSt has a shell-owned contact store with a single-value Contact record, substring search, vCard export and a Contacts app; apps get no SDK API for contacts, and there is no people picker, person view, groups, photos, or change notifications.

features.feature: Address book store and person records
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/contacts.rs (access, fetch, save, decode_contacts); springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (Contact struct, atomic save to Contacts/contacts.tsv)
features.note: Apps ask for access, fetch the fields they may see and save changes through the contacts service, and the reply decoding is tested inline in contacts.rs. Gap: the shell keeps the store and the record format, and no person record type is shared with the shell. Built 2026-10-17: SDK contacts::fetch, save and matching cover read, write and search for apps (SDK contacts tests).

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (Contact.labels, LABELS); wired: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/extras.rs; src/contacts.rs (card rows for extra values)
features.note: The store keeps one phone, one email and one address per contact, with label indexes. More phones and emails, URLs, a birthday and dates come from the contacts sidecar and are returned labeled by the SDK and the contacts service, tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs (sidecar round trip, labeled fetch). Gap: the Contacts app still edits one value of each, with no primary value and no arbitrary number of entries. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (search, substring match over name, phone, email, notes, company, address); wired: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs (list_hits)
features.note: The case-insensitive substring match over name, phone, email, notes, company and address is tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs (search). Gap: only a single text query; no property-scoped or compound search elements. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity. Built 2026-10-17: SDK contacts::matching searches one property case-insensitively over fetched records (test a_search_matches_one_property_ignoring_case).

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 6 (b02, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. Favorites is a flag on the contact; there are no group records or membership Built 2026-10-17: SDK contacts::groups exposes the group model (test groups_nest_and_list_members_recursively). features.bifrost: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/exchange.rs (import, export; headless_vcard_tests); springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs (Item::from_contact, vcard() export); wired: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/exchange.rs (File menu: Import vCards..., Export vCard 3.0..., Export vCard 4.0...)

Verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: Overview: apps share contacts with other apps (Mail, Messages)
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/services.rs (plain_text, contact_item, copy_contact; headless_model_tests); springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs; springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (NativeSharingServicePicker); springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs; springboard/README.md (Contacts section, copy of phone and email)
features.note: A contact can be shared as a vCard and its values copied as text, one per line. Headless tests: the_plain_text_lists_the_non_empty_fields_one_per_line, an_unnamed_contact_is_labelled_contact. No SDK call lets an app receive a contact. Verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: Not an Address Book API (search goes through the Contacts framework on macOS)
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/services.rs (search_item, plan, SearchIndex::sync; headless_model_tests); springboard/sdk/src/quicksearch.rs (apps index their own contacts for the Search panel)
features.note: Each contact is indexed under contact.<id> with its name, company, phone and email as keywords, and the change plan sends only new or changed contacts and removes gone ones (a_contact_is_indexed_under_its_item_id_with_its_fields_as_keywords, the_index_plan_sends_new_and_changed_contacts_and_removes_the_gone_ones). Indexing is per app; the Contacts app is the only contacts source found.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests. Wave 4 (w4-address-book, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No callback when the contact store changes outside the app Built 2026-10-17: SDK contacts::history exposes the change store and observers (test a_batch_of_contact_changes_is_recorded_and_fetched_by_token). Built 2026-10-17 (shell): The shell logs each save (contactchanges.rs) and apps read the log with contacts::history::changes(token). Tests: contactchanges tests.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (theme-30, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No contacts permission type; the manifest only has storage Built 2026-10-17 (shell): Settings > App Permissions has a Contacts switch per app, and undecided apps queue the access sheet (privacy_permissions Kind::Contacts). Grants still reset on restart. Built 2026-10-17 (shell, round 4): Contact grants persist with the other privacy grants (privacy-grants.tsv); the picker sheet draws the open pick (contact_pick_sheet.rs).
Specific to Apple's Address Book action plug-in model; the Contacts app has no plug-in host

gaps: No SDK API for apps to read, write, or search contacts (the store is shell-internal).
No people picker or person view for apps to embed.
Contacts have one phone, one email and one address; no multi-value properties or primary value.
No groups or group membership; Favorites is a flag only.
No structured postal address fields or formatter.
No change notification when the store changes.
No contacts permission in the app manifest.
Apple deprecated this framework; the modern Contacts framework is the reference and is not covered in this batch.
